ROUND 4 / ideation_5 -- one candidate proposed: BEHTIE-SNAP.
Goal: pick a coupling position the three negative rounds did not test.
Read: round brief (3 losses: curved residual 0.05439, successor-barycentre shift 0.05165 moving 99.1% of items, PPMI fourth level 0.04823 with 6302 deep prefixes; baseline ~0.0679; gate 0.065), plus the measured facts that behaviour-CONTRAST correlates +0.7104 with recall while Gromov/depth weighting hurts and curvature is a gauge.
Observed/derived: Stage3 consumes only SID tuples, so any Stage-2 objective change that leaves the chosen codes identical is a no-op, and any change to item->code membership has already shown a monotone loss with deviation. Therefore the only safe shape is shape (A) with a MEASURED guard band, and the edit must be a single coordinate of an EXISTING level (no new level, no deleted code, no residual cascade) so prefix merging, off-geometry drift and argmin-pinned extra depth are all structurally excluded.
Open: whether the tie band is non-empty (band occupancy is reported; empty band = bit-identical baseline = recorded parity) and whether behaviour contrast of one level rises enough to move Stage3 per-position entropy.

FINAL ANSWER (candidate BEHTIE-SNAP) recorded here in summary because the full block exceeded the 4000-char record limit; the complete answer is printed in the session reply.
Shape (A): freeze the Stage-2 encoder and both codebooks; after Stage 2 run one deterministic pass over 24,556 items that may change exactly ONE coordinate of ONE existing level (l >= 2, chosen as the level with the largest measured behaviour impurity), and only among codes inside a tie band of width rho_l = that level's median squared quantisation error. Level-1 assignment and all shallower prefixes are unchanged by construction; no level added, no code deleted, no residual cascade (deeper codes kept stale).
Behaviour signal: PPMI rows of popularity-adjusted adjacent-pair transitions from the Stage-2 TRAIN split only, truncated to top 20, compressed to b_i in R^64 by a deterministic rank-64 truncated SVD.
Curvature: kappa = artanh(0.9)/q95(||b||), c = kappa^2 (fixed negative curvature anchored to the measured radial scale), exp_0^c placement of b~_i and of tangent-barycentre code centroids c~_k, geodesic d_{P,c}.
Coupling equation: k*(i) = argmin_{k in A_i} [0.5*||z_i-c_k||^2/rho_l - 0.5*exp(-d_{P,c}(b~_i,c~_k)/sigma_k)], A_i = {k: ||z_i-c_k||^2 <= ||z_i-c_{k(i)}||^2 + rho_l} capped at 32 nearest.
Switches: BEH=0 zeroes the curved similarity -> bit-identical baseline table; GEO=0 keeps A_i and placements but uses Euclidean distance; both-on is the one trained arm.
Why not the three observed losses: no item leaves its text code by more than one median quantisation error, no code is merged or removed, no extra level is added or argmin-pinned, and the edit direction is the measured POSITIVE recall predictor (behaviour contrast) rather than barycentre drift, Gromov/depth weighting, or prefix fragmentation.
Cost: 0 added FLOPs across the 72,000 Stage-2 steps, Stage-3 untouched; post-hoc SVD minutes on CPU plus under a second of GPU geodesic work.
Observables: band occupancy, moved count, unchanged level-1 prefix count, depth-l and full-SID counts vs baseline, intra-code contrast before/after, per-position Stage-3 entropy, test_recall@10.
Open risks: empty band (parity, inert mechanism, recorded with occupancy), radial preference creating singleton deep prefixes, contrast gain too small for seed noise.
